Commentary.Commentary: Right then! 336 is what New Zealand need to stay alive in the series. Let me tell you, they have never lost an ODI at this venue. With shorter boundaries and the hunger to keep their hopes alive, expect them to come out all guns blazing. Will they be able to chase this down or will England seal the deal today? Join us back for the run chase in just a bit...

However, Tom Curran in the final over took Southee for a ride as he scored 18 runs to gain the momentum back heading into the break. New Zealand gave away too many at the start. All their bowlers were found wanting by the English batsmen. It was the part-timer, Munro who got them the breakthrough only for Sodhi to take over from there. The leggie picked up 4 and stopped the bleeding along with Boult. Southee had a day to forget as he was taken for aplenty.

Once that happened, Root joined forces with Bairstow and the duo then took the carnage forward. They amassed a huge 190-run stand for the second wicket with both scoring their respective tons. England were 267-1 when they lost Bairstow and they decided to promote Buttler up the order. The move didn't work and instead that led to a collapse. They lost next 8 wickets for just 46 runs and it seemed like they would not even play out their full quota of overs.

What a turnaround from New Zealand this has been. Simply outstanding and something that needs to be applauded. After being swatted around the park, New Zealand came back well in the end to restrict England under 350 which at once seemed easily on the cards. It all started with Roy and Bairstow who just didn't take anytime to settle. They raised a 77-run stand before the former departed.

CURRAN MAKES IT IN! He nearly had struck another boundary. Southee angles in a fuller ball on the stumps, Curran drags it off the inner half towards deep square leg where Nicholls dives full length to his right to stop it inside the boundary line. He then releases a quick throw to the keeper who disturbs the stumps. The umpire checks it upstairs to see if Curran has made it in. Replays confirm he has. 18 runs off the final over and ENGLAND HAVE 335 ON THE BOARD FOR THE LOSS OF 9 WICKETS!
They have gone upstairs to check for a run out. Has Curran completed the second run?
FOUR! Boom! Makes room to a slower length ball and slams it over extra cover. Can he make it 5 in 5?

FOUR! Make it three in a row! Tom Curran is winning a mini battle here! A low full toss, this time outside off, Curran goes hard at it and as a result he slices it down to third man to find the fence for the third time.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! A full toss on the stumps, Curran clears the front leg and thumps it straight back down the ground for another boundary.
FOUR! What was that from Curran! He gets across to a fuller ball and scoops it over fine leg for a boundary.
Yorker to begin with, Tom looks to bring his bat down to dig it out but fails to do so.
Tries for another yorker but it turns out to be a low full toss. Mark punches it through backward point and comes back for a brace. Good over from Boult, just 4 off it!
Fifth yorker in a row. Wood digs out to the cover fielder.
This is good bowling from Boult! Once again bowls a yorker, number 11 could just jam it out towards backward point.
Another yorker from Trent, Tom slices it behind point for a single.
Yorker on middle and off, Wood squeezes it out to third man for a single.
Mark Wood is the last man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Beautiful delivery from Boult! He goes wide of the crease and angles in a yorker on middle and off. Rashid looks to steer it away but the ball tails away and knocks the stumps behind. Will England play out their 50 overs?

Was that off the edge? Fuller ball, straying down leg, Rashid looks to flick it away but it goes off something to the keeper who dives to his left but couldn't take it cleanly. The umpire signals it as leg bye as it flicked the pads on its way.

FOUR! Smart shot! Southee bangs in a short one on middle and off, Rashid stays calm, waits for the ball to come and then when it arrives he just ramps it over Tom Latham and picks up a cheeky boundary.
Makes room to a length ball and slaps it through the cover region for one.
Lovely stop! Back of a length ball outside off, punched towards sweeper cover where Boult makes a diving stop near the boundary line to save a boundary for his side.
Good length outside off, punched back to the bowler who makes a good stop in his followthrough.
Tom Curran is the new man in.

OUT! Caught down the leg side! Tim Southee finally gets a wicket to his name. He drops a short ball down the leg side, Root swivels to pull but it's the cutter from Tim. The ball goes off the gloves and Latham accepts a regulation. Root shakes his head as he starts to walk back. New Zealand continue to chip away at the wickets.
Fuller ball sprayed wider outside off, Root slices it towards third man where de Grandhomme does well to cut that off. A single to end the over.

11th ODI ton for Joe Root! It has been a superb knock from him. Now then, since he has got to his milestone, can he finish well? Walks across to a fuller ball and works it wide of long on. Calls for two and completes it easily in the end. Removes the helmet, kisses the badge on it and takes a second to sink in all the applause.
Inside edge! Rashid goes hard at a length ball outside off, squirts an inside edge past leg pole for a single towards fine leg.
Fuller ball on off, driven square on the off side to move to 99!
Angling away on a length outside off, Rashid opens the face of the bat and guides it uppishly past backward point for one. 300 up for England as well. It has taken them quite a while to reach there.
Slants away a short ball on off from over the wicket, Root rises, fetches it from there to pull it to deep square leg for a single.
Trent Boult to bowl his 9th over now.
Hangs back to a back of a length ball and steers it down to third man to keep strike. Root on 97!
Slower delivery from Southee, Rashid waits for it to come and then flicks it through square leg for a single.
Fuller delivery, angling in, wristed towards long on for a single.
Change of bat for Root now...
Another one on a similar length, Root punches it towards mid on.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Rashid taps it towards backward point for a single.
Fuller ball in the zone outside off, Adil looks to drive but fails to put any bat on it.
Tim Southee back on.
Tossed up outside off, driven past cover for a single. Ish Sodhi finishes his spell with figures of 10-1-58-4! Stupendous!
Wide! Bowls a wrong 'un but it turns down leg, Rashid leaves it alone.
Punched towards cover for a single.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up wider outside off, Root gets down and sweeps it along the ground towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Flighted ball outside off, Rashid takes  a stride forward and drives it towards long off for a single.
Tossed up around middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
Defended off the back foot towards the off side.
Adil Rashid is the new man in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Terrible from England! Munro lands it on a length on middle, Chris Woakes dances down the track and just goes on with a lofted shot down the ground. Doesn't get any meat behind the shot and Boult from long on charges to his left and takes a good catch. Since Bairstow's wicket, England have lost 6 wickets for 21 runs in 38 balls, bizarre!
On a length outside off, dabbed towards backward point.
Fuller in length and on the pads, clipped towards deep square leg for a single.
Knuckle ball outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
Fuller in length and angling in, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Colin Munro to bowl now.
Loopy ball outside off, driven through cover for a single. 9-1-52-4 read Ish's figures, with an over to go, can he pick up a 5-fer?
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flighted ball around middle, swept towards mid-wicket for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Short and outside off, slapped past point for a single.
Chris Woakes is the new man in.

OUT! There goes another! Southee with a terrific catch this time! New Zealand surely have their tails up. 4th wicket for Sodhi and he is over the moon. But hold on, England what are you up to? Ali doesn't pick the wrong 'un as he looks to flick it away but the ball turns and he ends up getting a leading edge over mid off. Southee charges in, covers a lot of ground and dives with his hands outstretched to pluck an impressive catch.
Another yorker, dipping, jammed off the inner half through square leg for a single. What an over, just one off it.

In the air... in and out of de Grandhomme's hands! Tough chance, very tough! But we saw him pulling a stunner in the second  ODI when he dismissed Root. Boult hurls it on a length outside off, after facing four dot ball Ali decides to thrash one. He drags the pull off the inner half and it flies towards de Grandhomme at mid-wicket who sticks his right hand out but the ball doesn't stick.
Fires in a yorker outside off, Ali brings his bat down to dig it out. Four dots now!
Boult goes fuller, angling in on middle, jammed out back to the bowler by Ali.
On a back of a length outside off, defended towards cover.
Back of a length delivery on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total. Another fruitful over from Sodhi, just 3 off it. He has two more to go.
Beaten! Googly around off, Ali comes forward to defend but it turns away to beat the outside edge not by much.
Drops it short on middle and off, punched towards cover for a single.
Flatter on middle, clipped through square leg for a single.
Moeen Ali is the new man in.

OUT! Got him! England are falling now, they have lost 4 quick wickets for just 9 runs! Rejoice for New Zealand. Sodhi picks up his third and lets out a huge roar! Floats it up around middle and off, Stokes gets down on one knee to play the slog sweep. He does play it well but finds the man at deep mid-wicket to perfection. It's Henry Nicholls who takes it easily at the rope.
Googly around off, Stokes punches it off the back foot.
Powerplay 3 now. Maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the circle. Sodhi will continue.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single. Another successful over for the hosts.
On middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a single.
Ben Stokes arrives next.

OUT! In the air... taken! This is turning out to be a good passage of play for New Zealand! Good change in bowling once again from Williamson. Boult drops it short on middle, Eoin dances down the track to play the pull but the ball gets big on him. He mistimes it high in the air and Munro from mid on takes a good catch running backwards.
Back of a length ball, angling in and cramping Morgan for room who could just stab it out.
FOUR! Chips it away! Fuller and veering on the pads, Eoin just chips it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Effortless!
Shortish outside off, slapped towards sweeper cover for a single.
Trent Boult is back into the attack.
Bowls the googly, turning away from the southpaw, Morgan defends. What an over from the leggie, just 2 and a wicket off it.

A huge appeal for an LBW! Tossed up around middle and leg, Morgan goes back to tuck it away but misses and wears a bit high on the pads. Sodhi appeals but the umpire turns it down, indicating that height was an issue there.
Loopy ball outside off, driven through cover for a single.
Floated delivery outside off, Morgan opens his account with a drive down to long on.
Eoin Morgan walks out to bat next.

OUT! Good return catch! So the ploy to send Buttler up the order doesn't work for England as he bags a duck! Flatter delivery, on a shorter length outside off. Jos goes back to punch but does so uppishly towards the left of Ish who dives low and takes a great catch. New Zealand surging a comeback?
Tossed up outside off, driven towards cover.
Ish Sodhi back on.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Good length ball on middle, defended.
So, England have promoted Jos Buttler. Expect some more carnage.
Jos Buttler is the new man in.

OUT! A wicket against the run of play! Colin Munro has struck! A breathtaking innings from Jonny comes to an end as he walks off to a huge round of applause! Slower length delivery on the stumps, Bairstow looks to swing it across the line but is done in by the slowness on the ball. Gets a fat leading edge which spoons high up in the air. Southee from short third man calls for it and takes it safely near backward point.
FOUR! Deft touch! Waits for the short ball and steers it past Southee at short third man for a boundary.
SIX! 113 meter monster from Jonny! Once again reads the knuckle ball and dispatches it high and handsome over long on. The ball has disappeared again. Get the new ones please!
Back of a length outside off, tapped towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Slammed! De Grandhomme dishes out an absolute freebie! a full toss on the stumps and the next thing he sees is Jonny hitting it down the ground for a boundary. 12 off the over!
Shortish in length on middle and leg, clipped through square leg for a single.
In the air... falls short! Chips a fuller ball down to long on but doesn't carry to the fielder there.
SIX! Thrashed away! Waits for the slower length ball, it's the knuckle ball. Bairstow stays back deep and sends it packing over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum. his 6th of the innings!
Well bowled! Bowls a yorker on middle and leg, Bairstow could only jam it out back to the bowler.
On a back of a length outside off, cut away towards the cover-point fielder.
Another change. Colin de Grandhomme is brought into the attack. Southee and Williamson are seen having a word with the bowler.
Stays back to a length delivery and punches it down to long on to keep strike.
Gets down to play the paddle but misses to wear it on the chest.
What was that? The LED bails come off! It's off Latham's gloves which excites Munro! Bairstow makes room and dabs it towards backward point.
SIX! Dumps it! Reads the knuckle ball, stays leg side and just extends his arms to launch it over long off for a maximum.
Fuller ball on the stumps, Root dances down the track and lofts it to long on for a single.
Fuller ball outside off, driven towards mid off.
Colin Munro replaces Sodhi.
The batsman works it down the leg side. Two runs added to the total. 32 from the last 2 overs.
Looks to play the paddle at first but then adjusts and guides it down to third man at the last moment. A single taken.
SIX! Hugeee! On a back of a length outside off, Root stays put and pulls it over mid-wicket. Makes good connection to send it sailing over the fence.
Shortish on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single. 150-run stand comes up between Root and Jonny.
Hops back to a back of a length delivery and steers it fine down to third man for a single.

FOUR! Sloppy! Sodhi gave away 16 in the previous over and now concedes a boundary too! Southee angles it in on middle, Bairstow clips it off the pads. Sodhi at short fine leg dives all over the ball. 20 runs from the last 7 balls.
Drinks called.
FOUR! 16 off the over, a big one for England! Short ball outside off, Root looks to pull but drags it off the inner half. Doesn't matter as it races away through square leg.
FOUR! Boom! Flighted ball outside off, Root gets down on one knee and unfurls a superb slog sweep over mid-wicket for a boundary.
This time Bairstow cuts one through the same region for a single.
Cuts it through cover for one.
FOUR! Nicely done! tossed up, a bit too full outside off, Root squeezes it past the man at short third man for a boundary.

Easily home! Dropped short on middle, Root pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and calls for two immediately. The fielder throws it to the keeper who takes the bails off as Root drags his bat in. They take it upstairs and replays find Root safely in. Two taken.
A run out appeal has been taken upstairs against Root but the batsman seems to be comfortably home...
Ish Sodhi is back into the attack, replacing Santner.

A huge, huge appeal for a caught behind! Good length delivery outside off, Bairstow looks to pull it across the line but seems to have missed it. However, there is some noise as the ball passes the bat which makes the Kiwis put in a strong appeal. Nothing from the umpire and replays confirm it has brushed Jonny's pads.

Good stop in the deep! Very full on the pads, Root moves inside the line and clips it behind square on the leg side. Munro comes rushing to his right, slides and pulls the ball back in play to save a run for his side.
On a length and outside off, defended towards backward point.
Southee with another short ball outside off, Bairstow cuts uppishly towards third man for a single.
Gets forward but drives it straight to mid off.
Shortish on middle, swiped through mid-wicket for a single. 200 comes up for England!
Santner ends his spell with  a dot ball. Bairstow goes back and punches it towards the leg side. Mitchell's figures are 10-0-57-0!

FOUR! Beats the man at 45! And that's a ton for Jonny Bairstow! He needs a lot of praise here, came out all guns blazing and has made sure that he gets a big one under his belt! Third in this format and a huge round of applause follows next. Well played, JB! Santner drops it short and it's down the leg side. The English opener gets down on one knee and pulls it past the man at short fine leg for a boundary to celebrate the milestone.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On the leg stump, slogged towards deep square leg where Guptill makes a diving stop. A single.
Tossed up outside off, driven along the ground through cover for one,
Drops it short outside off, punched towards sweeper cover for a single.
Short and very close to the off stump line, Joe looks to cut but gets beaten.
SIX! What a hit! Woaaah! That's some way to bring up the 28th ODI fifty, Root! Well played! Jumps down the track to a length delivery and smokes it with full power over long on for a biggie.
Bairstow runs it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, stabbed out towards cover.
Back of the hand delivery, Root goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Starts his spell with a length delivery on the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Tim Southee is back into the attack. 4-0-28-0 read his figures so far. Can he break this stand?
Santner drops it short on middle, pulled towards deep square leg for a brace.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Covers the line and defends it down.
Goes back and punches it through cover for one.

Another shout for an LBW! Slower one around off, Root once again sits down to play the reverse paddle but it goes off something towards short third man as Michell keeps pleading for an LBW. The umpire, however signals it as runs. Replays show there is no inside edge but Hawk Eye shows it to be going over the stumps.
Shorter one outside off, punched towards sweeper cover for a single.

A loud appeal for an LBW! Length ball, angling in on middle, Root looks to turn it around the corner but misses to get hit on the pads. Munro keeps appealing but umpire Tucker shakes his head. Replays show it's pitched in line and would have clipped the top of leg. So the umpire's call.
Brings up the 100-run stand between the two with a clip through square leg.
Good length ball on the pads, worked towards the leg side.
FOUR! Deft! Waits for the length ball outside off, makes room does Jonny and then at the last moment he opens the face of the bat to guide it down to the third man fence. Into the 90s!
Root eases it to long off and gets to the other end.
Fuller and angling in on middle, worked down to long on for a single.
Quicker again, landed around off, Root nearly chips one back to Santner who fails to collect it on the bounce.
Quicker full ball around off, pushed back down the pitch.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Root goes back to cut but chops it towards point.
Slower through the air outside off, bunted back to the bowler.
FOUR! Cheeky from Joe! A bit flatter through the air on middle and off, Root gets down and reverse paddles it over the keeper for a boundary. A premeditated shot from Root there.
Floated delivery around off, pushed towards the cover fielder.
Mitchell Santner is back.
Once again Munro keeps it full on off, stroked back in his direction by Jonny.
Fullish again on off, bunted back to Munro.
SIX! Murdered! Munro drops it short on middle, Bairstow stays back and pulls it with aplomb over square leg for his fourth maximum of the game.
Fuller in length on off, defended back to the bowler.
Drifts it on the pads, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Good stop, Southee! Munro keeps it full outside off, Joe drives it towards cover where the Kiwi pacers dives full stretch to his left and stops it with one hand to save some runs for his side.
Shortish and skidding off a touch, Bairstow tries working it through the leg side but gets it off the thigh pad back to the bowler.

Beaten! Hurls it on a back of a length, angles it away and it zips off the surface a touch. Bairstow looks to cut but the line is too close to play that shot. Gets beaten on the outside edge by a whisker.
Back to over the wicket and this time he fires a wide yorker outside off, Jonny crouches to squeeze it out but fails to do so.
Goes around the wicket does Boult and angles it in on middle and leg, Root hops and clips it down to fine leg for one.
Drops it short on middle and leg, Bairstow pulls it off the inner half through backward square leg for another single.
Fuller and angling away outside off, driven neatly towards sweeper cover for a single.
Half chance! Fuller in length on middle, Jonny hits it hard and uppishly towards the bowler who can't get down in time and the ball hits his leg and goes to mid off.
Shortish outside off, Jonny waits for it and cuts it through point for a brace.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Worked around the corner and the call is for two. However, Jonny slips as he completes one and they are happy with a run.
Good length on middle, driven down to long on for a run.
On the pads, Root misses the flick to get hit on the pads.
Another short ball outside off, JB tries to drag his pull but misses.

Is that glove? The umpire does not feel so. A short ball on middle, Bairstow tries to pull but it goes off something to the keeper. The Kiwis appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Replays later show that it flicked the helmet on its way.
The batsman guides it to third man.
Guides it through point for a run.

DROPPED! Santner is the culprit. A sitter by his standards, really. He took a good catch before but drops the one he should have taken. On a length around off, Bairstow strokes it uppishly towards Mitchell at covers. He gets two hands to it but it bursts through and goes towards mid off for a run. They needed that too be taken as JB is looking very dangerous out there. How costly will this prove?
Back of a length on off, pushed through covers for a run.
Trent Boult is back into the attack.
Just behind a length on off, guided towards point for a run.
Length around off, kept out.
Slower ball outside off, guided down towards short third man for a run.
On the pads, tries to clip but misses to get hit high on the pads.

FOUR! Excellent effort but in vain! Feel sorry for Santner there. A short ball which is pulled towards him at square leg. He runs to his right and dives full stretch, tries to push the ball in but is not able to do so. A boundary results.
Back of a length on off, pushed through covers for a run.
Bowls the arm ball on middle, kept out.
Quicker on off, cut to point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Goes down on one knee to the delivery down the leg side and sweeps it hard through square leg for a boundary.
Fires it in on off, kept out.
Hit through covers for an easy run.
Goes for the bouncer, it hurries onto Root as he mistimes his pull towards short fine leg for a run.
Fuller on middle, worked down to long on for a run.
On the pads, flicked through square leg to add a run to the total.
On middle, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Angles it into the pads, JB works it around the corner to change strike.
On the stumps, worked around the corner for a run.
Colin Munro is into the attack now.
SIX! 50-run stand up in quick time again! This time this is just chipped! Floats it up on middle, Jonny plants his front foot forward and sends it sailing over the long on fence.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Just short! Santner tosses this one up on middle, Bairstow pushes at it with hard hands but luckily for him it lands just in front of the bowler.
Quicker on the stumps, punched down to long off for a run.
Fires it on the pads, worked towards square leg for a run.
Eased down to long off for a run.
Flatter on off, JB keeps it out.
SIX! BANG! Picked the bones out of that one! The googly on off, JB picks it up and dispatches it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Flighted ball on off, guided to covers.
Flatter on the stumps, Root mistimes his pull towards square leg for a run.
Slower through the air on off, turning away. Root tries to drive but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to short third man.
Loopy ball on off, driven to covers.
Quicker on the shorter side on off, JB chops it to point.
Flatter on off, defended.
Beaten! Nice bowling! Flatter on off, it turns away sharply. Jonny lunges forward and tries to defend but gets beaten.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floats it up on off, driven through covers for a run.
Flatter on off, punched to covers.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.

CLOSE SHAVE! A half-tracker by Sodhi on the stumps. Root rocks back and tries to pull it out of the ground but he gets an inside edge onto his boot and the ball goes agonizingly close past the leg pole and rolls towards the keeper. New Zealand need these kind of things to go their way, it is all going England's way right now.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Fifty for Bairstow, it is his 7th in ODIs. An excellent innings from the opener, he has looked to attack right from the outset. He taps the flighted ball towards cover for a quick run to get to that milestone.
The ball was hit so far that it is lost. The box comes out and it has been replaced.
SIX! That is out of here! Wow! What a hit! A flighted ball on middle, Bairstow tonks it over long on for a maximum.
Eased down to long off for a run.
Taps it towards cover for a quick run to end the over.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! This time he hits it from the middle. Mitchell floats it up on leg stump. Bairstow goes down on one knee and sweeps it hard through square leg for a boundary. 100 up for England.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.

In the air... but Jonny gets away with it. A fuller ball on middle by Santner. Bairstow goes for the sweep but it takes the top edge but just out of the reach of short fine leg who runs to his right and stops it on the bounce.
Shortish on off, pushed through covers for a run.
Flighted ball on off, eased down to long off for a run. Just 19 from the last 5 and also a wicket. Good passage for New Zealand, the run rate though is still more than 6.
The googly outside off but on the shorter side, Jonny rocks back and punches it through covers for a run.
Loopy ball on off, eased to covers.
Swept hard but straight to the fielder! Floats it up on middle, Root goes down on one knee and sweeps it hard but to the fielder at deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! Bad ball and dispatched! Short and on the stumps, Root goes down on one knee and pulls it through square leg and the ball races away.
Gives it air on off, driven to covers.
Drinks!
Fires it on the stumps, pushed down to long on for a run.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
FOUR! Uses his feet well, gets to the pitch of the ball and slices it with one hand through covers for a boundary.
Floats it up on off, driven to covers.
Flatter on off, Jonny guides it towards point and sets off for a run. Ross is quick to the ball but fails to pick it up and the batsman add a run to the score.
Shortish on off, Root has all the time in the world to rock back and stroke it through covers for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Almost gets another! A wrong 'un outside off, it dips on the batsman as he tries to drive it through the off side against the spin. The ball takes the inside edge and goes towards short fine leg for a run.
Loopy ball on off, driven down to long off to change strike.
The googly outside off, Jonny plants his front foot forward and defends it.
Very full on middle, eased down to long on for a run.
7th dot ball for Sodhi, floats it up on off, Root drives it to covers.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.
Full on off, driven to covers.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Nicely bowled but it costs him runs! Slower through the air outside off, it turns away a little. Jonny tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes through short third man for a brace.
On the shorter side on middle, Bairstow goes back and tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. There is a stifled appeal by the players but the umpire stays put.
Flatter on off, Jonny lunges forward and keeps it out.
Flatter on middle, defended. A wicket maiden by Sodhi, excellent by the wrist spinner.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy ball on the fuller side on off, driven to covers.
Floats it up on off, kept out.
Joe Root comes out at no. 3.

OUT! It's a clean take from Santner! Sodhi strikes in his first over! Just what he was brought into the attack for by Williamson and he will be a relieved man seeing the back of Roy. Not the best of deliveries by Sodhi but he will take it. A short ball around leg stump, Roy looks to pull but he seems to have hit it twice and the ball lobs towards Santner at short fine leg. Mitchell knew it is going to die in front so he quickly runs forward, dives and grabs a brilliant low catch inches above the ground. Roy though feels it is not clean and he waits there. The umpires take it upstairs to check. Replays show that Santner's hands are underneath the ball. The Kiwis are pumped up as they needed this badly. Roy was taking the game away from them. He goes for an entertaining innings and the 77-run stand has been broken. Can the hosts pull things back now?
Has Santner taken a stunner? He certainly feels so but Roy wants it to be checked upstairs and the umpires do so. Looks clean to me.
Nicely bowled! Tosses it up on off, kept out.
Spin from both ends as Ish Sodhi comes into the attack.
Powerplay 2 signaled! Now they can place 4 fielders outside the 30-yard circle and they surely need extra protection at the moment.
Eased down to long off for a run. 77 runs from the first Powerplay, outstanding start.
TURN AND BOUNCE! Quicker on off, it turns and bounces away from the batsman who tries to cut but misses.
Flatter on off, defended.
Fires it on middle, worked away towards square leg for a run.
FOUR! Effortless! Santner tosses it up on off, Bairstow makes room and goes inside out over covers for a boundary.
Starts off with a low full toss on middle, Roy drives it down the ground for a run.
Spin for the first time today! Mitchell Santner is into the attack.
FOUR! Uppish but away from the fielder! Too easy for the English men! Fullish on off, Jonny drives it uppishly but away from mid off and the ball races away. The partnership is upto 70.
Fuller on middle, driven down to long on for a run.
WIDE! Bowls it outside the leg stump, Roy goes for the flick but misses. The crowd gets excited as there is some noise as the ball passes the bat but that is off the bat hitting the pads.
A little too straight by Colin, Bairstow works it around the corner for a run.
Fuller on off, driven crisply to mid off.
FOUR! Not a good ball with your third man up! Short and wide outside off, Jonny cuts it through point and the ball races away.
Good length on off, driven to covers.
Colin de Gradhomme is into the attack. He needs to provide a breakthrough here.
Short and wide outside off, Roy looks to cut but gets a bottom edge and the ball rolls beside the pitch.
Down the leg side and the umpire stretches his hands to signal it a wide.
FOUR! Clever batting, very clever batting! Boult comes around the wicket and bangs it in short. Roy waits for it and plays the upper cut over the keeper for another boundary.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Full and wide outside off, the sucker ball. Roy goes after it but only connects with thin air.
Back of a length on off, kept out.

Not out! Well, it was pad first but it was pitching outside leg. I did not see that coming though. A desperate review from New Zealand to be honest. A length ball shaping back in late around middle. Roy did not account for the swing as he tries to keep it out with the bat close to the pad. The Kiwi players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. After a chat with his teammates, Williamson goes for the review. Replays show it is pad first but it has pitched outside leg and it also looks to be going over the stumps. A waste of a review by the hosts and they lose their sole one.
Is that bat or pad first? New Zealand certainly feel it is pad as they have referred for an LBW after the umpire gives it not out. Roy is the man in question. Height also can be an issue here.
Good length on off, pushed down to long on for an easy run. Roy moves onto 35 with that single.
Another length ball around off, pushed with confidence towards mid off.
SIX! All the way! Slower ball by Southee around off, Roy picks it and lofts it over mid off for a biggie. Fifty comes up for England in just 40 balls. This is some start!
Angles it into the batsman, Roy works it to mid-wicket.
Slower ball on off, Roy buries it onto the ground.
On the pads, Bairstow flicks it through square leg. This time though there is protection in the deep and it is only a run.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. Another big over as 11 comes from it.
Fullish on middle, driven to mid on.

SIX! First of the game! Short and on middle, Roy, maybe expected it as he was into the position early to counter it. Swivels a touch and pulls it with disdain as the ball flies over the square leg fence for half a dozen. Cracking!
Bowls it in the avenue of apprehension. Roy blocks it.
Once again Roy dances down the track and this time Boult shortens his length. Jason misses the flick and is hit near the box. He is in a little pain here but seems okay to continue.

Five overthrows! Boult is not happy here! A good delivery by him as he lands it on a length around off, Bairstow tries to defend but gets an inside edge on the leg side. Roy calls him for a single and he obliges. The keeper is quick to the ball and has a needless shy at the bowler's end but he misses. There is nobody backing up and the ball races to the long off fence.
Just ahead of a length on off, Roy drives it on the up towards mid on for no runs. End of the first five overs and England are going at 7 per over here.
On the pads, Roy misses the flick to get hit on the thigh pad.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
Offers width again outside off, Roy cuts it towards third man for a brace. The Kiwi bowlers haven't got it right here.
FOUR! Top class shot! Fullish on off, Roy leans into it and drives it beautifully through extra covers.

A huge appeal but Roy was a long way down there! Jason shimmies down the track and tries to flick the ball on off through the leg side. He misses though and it hits him high on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.

FOUR! Through the gap! England off to a flier here. Once again it's the length ball, Boult offers a little width to Bairstow which is enough for him to time it past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
Good length angling away form the batsman. Jonny mistimes his drive towards cover.
Nicely driven but for no runs! Fuller on off, Bairstow eases it off the middle but straight to Williamson to mid off.
On the leg pole and Bairstow couldn't take toll of it as he flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, Jonny keeps it out with a back foot defense.

Good work by Munro! Boult bowls it on the pads, too easy for Roy as he flicks it through mid-wicket. Munro gives it  a chase from square leg and manages to push it back just before the ball crosses the rope. Saves a run for his side.
Once again on the stumps, kept out. Another over which costs 8 runs. England off to a good start.
Good length on middle, Bairstow pushes it back towards the bowler who has a shy at the keeper's end but it hits the batsman instead.
A scrambled seam delivery on middle, Bairstow tries to push it down the ground but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On the off pole, Jonny tries to drive but it goes off the inner half towards mid off.

FOUR! Down the ground this time! Not a lot wrong with this delivery. Fuller on middle, Jonny lofts it over mid on and once it beats the infield, there is no stopping the ball. Back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Dealing in boundaries here are England. Southee errs in line and bowls it on the pads. Bairstow uses his wrists and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. An expensive start by Boult, 8 runs from his first.

FOUR! Clumsy by Williamson there, A shorter in length ball outside off, Roy rocks back and punches it off the middle through covers.  Williamson from mid off hares after it, dives and tries to push it back in but is not able to do so. The skipper will be disappointed there as he must have felt he could have stopped that.
Back of a length on off, guided to point.
Another ball just ahead of a length. Shaping back in late. Roy adjusts well and flicks it to mid-wicket.

EDGED BUT FOUR! Fuller around off this time by Boult, he gets it to shape back in. Roy tries to go straight but gets an inside edge which goes close past the leg pole and down to the fine leg fence. Two boundaries for Roy and both haven't been convincing.
Hits the length straightaway on off, it comes in a little. Roy pushes it to mid on.
Trent Boult will bowl with the second new ball. He took a fifer the last time he bowled here, can he repeat the same?
A good ball to finish! On a length closer to the off pole but not close enough for the batsman to play at it. 5 from the first over.
Southee goes wide of the crease and angles it on off. Roy times it well towards mid off where Williamson misfields and concedes a run.
Bowls it on a length around off, Roy leaves it alone.
Length ball around off, it straightens a touch. Roy is squared up as he tries to defend but does manage to keep it out.
FOUR! Off the mark in style! A little short on middle, Roy pulls it in unconvincing manner but in the gap through square leg and the ball races away.
A good delivery first up, gets some shape too, encouraging signs. Southee bowls it on a length outside off, it shapes away further. Roy makes a watchful leave.

So, we are all set for the action to begin. It is bright and sunny, perfect cricketing conditions. The men who matter make their way out to the middle. Jason Roy and Jonny Bairstow will open the batting for the visitors. The former will be taking strike and he will be facing Tim Southee who will bowl with the first new ball. He has two slips in place waiting for the outside edge. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Mark Richardson says, it is a better surface than the one Pakistan and New Zealand played on earlier this summer. Further adds there is a good grass covering on top. Reckons there might be some moisture underneath it and the pacers might get some movement. Ends by saying the spinners might get some slow turn.
Eoin Morgan too wanted to bowl first as it is the first day game. Informs they are unchanged. Mentions they have to be good with bat and ball if they are to seal the series today.

Kane Williamson mentions that the wicket has been under the cover for the last couple of days so they will look to exploit it. Informs Ross Taylor comes in for Mark Chapman. Hopes to put up a complete performance in order to win this game and stay alive.
TOSS - Kane Williamson flips the coin, Eoin Morgan calls for a head but it lands the opposite. New Zealand win the toss and opt to field.

2-1 is the scoreline after 3 games, three very good games I should say and we now head to Dunedin for the 4th ODI between New Zealand and England. A must-win for the hosts if they are to keep the series alive. They though have been handed a boost by the return of their in-form batsman, Ross Taylor who missed the last game due to an injury. They would hope for him to bring the stability to the middle order which they have been lacking in the last two games. England, on the other hand, will look to seal the series here today. They are unlikely to make any changes to their eleven from the last game as all their players have stepped up whenever required. Eoin Morgan will hope for the same to continue. Let us hope for another cracking encounter as we welcome you to our coverage. Toss coming up in just a bit...
